_note: Alt-text meaningfulness ground truth for Spike A (B2.2). Each image in data/fixtures/vision-gallery.html gets one meaningful alt (label yes) and three placeholder alts (label no). Placeholder alts are ironclad negatives — a filename or 'image' is not meaningful regardless of what the image shows. The judge should return 'no' on negatives and 'yes'/'unknown' on positives; a 'no' on a positive is a false positive.
